prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
| Return 3m            | +16.2% |
| Return 1m            | -6.1% |
| Return 1w            | -1.5% |
| Range position (63d) | 61% |
| 21d realized vol     | 23% |
| Last close           | 114.20 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response: The stock shows mixed momentum: a strong 3-month gain but a negative 1-month and slight weekly pullback, indicating near-term softness within a range-bound pattern (63-day range at 61% occupancy) and modest volatility (21d realized vol ~23%). Given the mixed signals and lack of a clear short-term breakout, a cautious stance is prudent for the next 20 trading days. DECISION: HOLD
